description: Hand-labelled eval set for extract_claims(). Each case lists every (competency, source) pair a correct extraction should return. Labelling rule: include a competency for a text only when that text clearly states the provider has the skill, training or qualification. Exclude negations, future plans, other people's skills, vague statements, and qualifications below the competency's bar (e.g. basic BSL is not 'Fluent in BSL').
